title: Unit 17 Consolidation: Regional Geopolitics, Diplomatic Strategy & Transnational Coalitions
goal: I can talk about diplomacy, borders and alliances in Hungarian.
I can use careful wording, place and direction pairs, noun chains, *mielőtt még … volna* and *miként … akként …*.
I can say what Jenő Szűcs's essay says about the three historical regions of Europe.
